name: yami-motion
description: YAMI motion / animation spec — easing, durations, patterns

files.summary: Single-family easing: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). 4 variants (default / enter / exit / linear). No bounces, no spring physics.
Concrete patterns: button hover/press, modal open/close, dropdown, toast, page transition, loading, focus ring. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

relatedSkill: yami-motion (Phase 9+ if motion diverges enough to warrant its own skill)
notes: Phase 0 spec based on Framer Motion + CSS transitions defaults observed in Claude Design export. Authoritative motion spec matures after live app feedback; rule-ids may be added to ../design.md in later phases.
